service.description: Internal: wake this node's push worker once the caller's transaction commits (at once outside one; nothing on a rollback).

Internal: one round of the push worker now, or at nowMillis (the tests' simulated clock): the jobs into the outbox, the held pushes of users no longer on do not disturb, then the pushes due. Out: jobCount (jobs worked), queuedCount (outbox rows written or merged), sentCount, retriedCount, failedCount, droppedCount (read before they went).

Internal (mark#Read, mark#AllRead): the user read rooms up to readMap's eventSeq (chatRoomId to lastReadEventSeq). Their pushes of those rooms not yet sent, up to it, are dropped; each device (but the one of this request's device key) that was sent one gets a clear push, so it removes the room's notification. In the caller's transaction; the worker is woken after the commit.

Internal (Calls.js ring): of userIdList, the users whose devices a call from fromUserId rings (plans/Comms-Messaging.md §7.2 rule 4): everyone not on do not disturb, and on do not disturb a user whose allowed list (the preference CHAT_DND_ALLOWED, userIds joined by commas, in Chat settings beside the hours) has the caller, or whom the same caller called in the 3 minutes before (another call than callSessionId). A call from no user (an outside number) does not ring a user on do not disturb.
